title.narrative: Integrated Urban Flood Management for the Chennai-Kosasthalaiyar Basin Project

description.narrative: The project will strengthen climate and disaster resilience in the Chennai-Kosasthalaiyar River basin. It will reduce the exposure of 1.9 million people to seasonal flooding by (i) improving climate-resilient urban flood protection infrastructure; (ii) enhancing urban flood preparedness of the Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC), the civic body that governs the city of Chennai, and project communities; and (iii) establishing measures for sustaining the operation and maintenance (O&M) of the stormwater drainage system in the GCC.

description.narrative: Climate and disaster resilience in the Chennai-Kosasthalaiyar River basin strengthened

1.9 million people living in the flood-prone areas of the Chennai-Kosasthalaiyar River basin protected from flood risk from a 1:2-year return period rainfall Progress/Status: The target year is 2028. The work is in progress and the target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: GCC reports, including rainfall data, flood area records, and flood-affected people records Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Climate-resilient urban flood protection infrastructure improved in the Chennai-Kosasthalaiyar River basin Indicator: 11 km stretches in four primary channels (Ambattur, Korattur, Kadappakkam, and Ariyallur) rehabilitated Progress/Status: To date, 16.5 km of stretches have been completed, exceeding the target of 11 km. Data Source: Project quarterly progress report, GCC annual reports Actual value:

Output: Climate-resilient urban flood protection infrastructure improved in the Chennai-Kosasthalaiyar River basin Indicator: 175 km of stormwater drains upgraded Progress/Status: The target year is 2027. The work is in progress and the target is likely to be achieved.
So far 107 km of stormwater drains upgraded against the target of 175 km. Data Source: Project quarterly progress report, GCC annual reports Actual value:

9,312 catchpits with rainwater harvesting structures constructed so far.
Data Source: Project quarterly progress report, GCC annual reports Actual value:
